text: Roll a d20 and compare it with the attribute named: equal or under succeeds, over fails. A 1 is always the best result.
Strength: muscle and toughness. Damage past Hit Protection comes off STR, and a failed STR save then takes the mouse out of the fight.
Dexterity: speed, stealth and reflexes. Dodging a blast or a falling rock is a DEX save.
Willpower: nerve and magic. Spells cost it, and fear is resisted with a WIL save.
Points subtracted from each hit's damage before it lands. Magic darts and other spells may ignore it.
One square of the table grid, about a mouse-length across. Ranges and areas count in cells.
